# Stop Chasing Global Variable

Source: [wiki article 4464](../archive/4464.md); edited 2024-11-26.

Exact pinned API: [Stop Chasing Global Variable](../../api/actions/stop-chasing-global-variable.md).

<a id="wiki-4464-n1"></a>

- Stopping a chase leaves the global variable at its current value rather than resetting or finishing it.
